We build tools when existing software falls short

We design and build quoting tools, portals and operational platforms around your business rules. Tools that integrate with your existing systems and bring spreadsheet, email and manual workflows into one application.

What we can build

Development can be a complete application or a feature extending your current tools.

Quoting and sales tools

If preparing a proposal means combining spreadsheets, prices and terms, we build a tool that applies those rules and keeps information linked to the sales process.

For example

A quoting tool with country-specific pricing, discounts and budget allocation, connected to the CRM.

Platforms for your operations

When management relies on separate records, we build an environment with the data, permissions and actions each person needs to do their job.

For example

A project dashboard linking services, teams, costs and billing.

Portals for clients and collaborators

If requests and follow-ups are scattered across emails and messages, we create a space where each person can initiate requests and check relevant information.

For example

A portal for requesting services, attaching documents and checking each request's status.

How we work

You can engage audit, design, implementation or support separately, depending on your project's stage. We agree on deliverables, budget and schedule before moving forward.

Decide whether development is needed

We review what each user needs to do and the limits of current tools. We compare configuring, integrating or building a custom feature to recommend an option and a first priority.

You receive

An assessment with alternatives, priorities and a scope recommendation.

Define a tool the team can validate

We agree on workflows, screens, rules, permissions and required connections. We scope an initial version and the criteria your team will use to confirm it meets the need.

You receive

Documented solution design and acceptance criteria, to continue with Cloudfianz or another team.

Build and test with real situations

We build the agreed solution and review it with its users. We test rules, permissions and integrations before launch. We can also start from an existing design after reviewing its materials.

You receive

The agreed version, testing and documentation, together with the code, configurations and handover defined in the proposal.

Support the product in use

We handle incidents, maintenance and minor adjustments with agreed monthly capacity. New features are assessed for scope before adding them to the work.

Includes

Service and maintenance within the contracted capacity, with tracking of product needs.

Frequently asked questions

Should we build software or adapt an existing tool?

We first assess whether configuration or integration solves the need. Custom development makes sense when existing options lack relevant features or rules. An audit can inform that decision.

Can the application connect to our CRM or ERP?

We review the APIs, permissions and restrictions of the tools involved. Then we define what information can be exchanged and which connections are in scope. Despegar, for example, uses its quoting tool from the HubSpot deal.

What determines cost and timeline?

The workflows, rules, integrations and users the solution must support, plus how much is defined at the start. We quote deliverables or milestones with a schedule. Licenses, infrastructure and third-party services are listed separately.

Can we continue the project with another team?

The design is documented to support continuity. For implementation, the proposal specifies the code, configurations and access to be transferred, along with third-party licenses and components.

What if we need changes after launch?

We can arrange support for incidents, maintenance and minor adjustments. New features are assessed by scope, and we agree on budget and schedule before including them.
